# lpplsF: Log-Periodic Power Law Singularity Model for Financial Bubbles

## Overview

`lpplsF` implements the Log-Periodic Power Law Singularity (LPPLS) model
for detecting and analysing financial bubbles. The package is based on:

1.  **Filimonov & Sornette (2013)**: A stable and robust calibration
    scheme of the log-periodic power law model. *Physica A: Statistical
    Mechanics and its Applications*.

2.  **Filimonov, Demos & Sornette (2017)**: Modified profile likelihood
    inference and interval forecast of the burst of financial bubbles.
    *Quantitative Finance*.

## Installation

``` r

# Install from GitHub (development version)
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("mahovo/lpplsF")

# Once on CRAN
# install.packages("lpplsF")
```

## Quick Start

``` r

library(lpplsF)

# Generate synthetic bubble data
set.seed(123)
t <- 1:200
true_params <- list(A = 4, B = -0.015, C1 = 0.002, C2 = 0.001,
                    tc = 250, m = 0.5, omega = 9)
log_p <- eval_lppls(t, true_params$A, true_params$B, true_params$C1,
                    true_params$C2, true_params$tc, true_params$m,
                    true_params$omega) + rnorm(200, 0, 0.01)

# Fit the LPPLS model
result <- fit_lppls(
  time_ID = t,
  log_price = log_p,
  fh = 100,           # Forecast horizon
  hold_out = 0,       # No holdout data
  tc_init = 250,      # Initial guess for critical time
  mode = "F2",        # Two-stage optimization
  num_searches = 20,  # Number of random starts
  fp = TRUE           # Generate fit plot
)

# View results
print(result$fit[[1]])

# Display fit plot
print(result$fit_plot)
```

## Model Description

The LPPLS model describes log-price dynamics approaching a critical
point:

\\y(t) = A + (t_c - t)^m \[B + C_1 \cos(\omega \log(t_c-t)) + C_2
\sin(\omega \log(t_c-t))\]\\

where:

- \\t_c\\ is the critical time (bubble peak)  
- \\m\\ is the power law exponent (typically 0.1-0.9)  
- \\\omega\\ (omega) is the log-periodic frequency (typically 6-13)  
- \\A\\, \\B\\, \\C_1\\, \\C_2\\ are linear parameters

The damping coefficient `D = m|B| / (ω√(C1² + C2²))` measures the
strength of oscillations relative to power law growth. Filimonov (2017)
suggests D ≥ 0.8 for valid bubble detection.

## Optimization Modes

| Mode  | Description                                                  |
|-------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| `F1`  | Simultaneous optimization of tc, m, ω                        |
| `F2`  | Two-stage: optimize (m, ω) for each tc, then select best tc  |
| `MPL` | Modified Profile Likelihood with confidence intervals for tc |

## Main Functions

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`fit_lppls()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/fit_lppls.md) | Main fitting function |
| [`eval_lppls()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/eval_lppls.md) | Compute LPPLS model values |
| [`SSE()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/SSE.md) | Compute sum of squared errors |
| [`fit_plot()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/fit_plot.md) | Generate fit visualization |
| [`sse_contour_plot()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/sse_contour_plot.md) | Generate SSE contour plots |

# Package index

## All functions

- [`SSE()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/SSE.md) : Sum of
  Squared Errors for the LPPLS Model
- [`chi_sq_lambda_plot()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/chi_sq_lambda_plot.md)
  : Plot the Lagrange-Regularized Objective with the Optimal Start Time
- [`chi_sq_np_plot()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/chi_sq_np_plot.md)
  : Plot the Normalized Residual Sum of Squares with Bias Trend
- [`eval_lppls()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/eval_lppls.md)
  : Log-Periodic Power Law Singularity (LPPLS) Model
- [`fit_lppls()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/fit_lppls.md)
  : Fit LPPLS Model to Financial Time Series
- [`fit_plot()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/fit_plot.md)
  : Plot a Fitted LPPLS Model
- [`lpplsF`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/lpplsF-package.md)
  [`lpplsF-package`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/lpplsF-package.md)
  : lpplsF: Log-Periodic Power Law Singularity Model for Financial
  Bubbles
- [`lppls_curvature()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/lppls_curvature.md)
  : Curvature of the LPPLS objective at the estimate
- [`lppls_lagrange()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/lppls_lagrange.md)
  : Lagrange Regularization of a Rolling-Window LPPLS Calibration
- [`lppls_noise_sweep()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/lppls_noise_sweep.md)
  : Calibrate an LPPLS signal across a range of noise levels
- [`lppls_rolling()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/lppls_rolling.md)
  : Rolling-Window LPPLS Calibration (rolling \\T_1\\, fixed \\T_2\\)
- [`lr_trend_test()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/lr_trend_test.md)
  : Autocorrelation-robust significance test for the Lagrange
  \\\chi^2\_{np}\\ trend
- [`noise_param_plot()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/noise_param_plot.md)
  : Parameter estimates against noise level
- [`noise_tc_plot()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/noise_tc_plot.md)
  : Critical-time estimate and likelihood intervals against noise level
- [`plot(`*`<lppls_fit>`*`)`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/plot.lppls_fit.md)
  : Plot an LPPLS calibration
- [`print(`*`<lppls_fit>`*`)`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/print.lppls_fit.md)
  : Print an LPPLS calibration with its diagnostics
- [`residual_qq_plot()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/residual_qq_plot.md)
  : Residual QQ Plot Diagnostic
- [`rolling_param_plot()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/rolling_param_plot.md)
  : Plot LPPLS Parameter Estimates Across Rolling T1
- [`rolling_tc_plot()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/rolling_tc_plot.md)
  : Plot tc Estimates and Likelihood Intervals Across Rolling T1
- [`spx`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/spx.md) : S&P 500
  Composite Index Daily Closing Level
- [`sse_contour_plot()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/sse_contour_plot.md)
  : Create Custom Contour Plot for SSE
- [`sse_surface_plot()`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/sse_surface_plot.md)
  : Plot the SSE landscape around a set of LPPLS parameter values
- [`summary(`*`<lppls_fit>`*`)`](https://mahovo.github.io/lpplsF/reference/summary.lppls_fit.md)
  : Full diagnostic summary of an LPPLS calibration
